name: Papa, Dakishimete Ageru ~Babumi na Manamusume no Bosei ni Amaete Nakadashi Zanmai~
original_name: パパ、抱きしめてあげる ～バブみな愛娘の母性に甘えて中出し三昧～
source: Miyu lost her mother and you've lost your wife some months ago. After a period of mourning your daughter sees you crying over your lost wife again. Concerned for your welfare she asks 'Papa, can I replace mama for you?' She lets you lie in her lap while she gives you a hand job. The next morning she wakes you up with a blowjob. Handjobs, blowjobs, paizuri, how far will Miyu go to replace your wife? How much will you reach out for her? Is it your wife you long for? Or your daughter?
translation: Miyu失去了她的母亲，而你几个月前也失去了你的妻子。经过一段时间的哀悼之后，你的女儿看到你再次为失去的妻子哭泣。关心你的福祉，她问“爸爸，我可以代替你妈妈吗？”她让你躺在她的腿上，同时给你做手工工作。第二天早上，她用口交叫醒你。打手枪、口交、paizuri，Miyu会走多远来取代你的妻子？你愿意为她付出多少？你渴望的是你的妻子吗？还是你的女儿？
